items.prompt: Which costs and correctness rules matter before choosing a sorted list for a high-update workload?
items.modelAnswer: Include preprocessing, lookup/range requirements, shifting insertion/deletion costs, key/comparison cost, duplicates/tie order, mutation ownership and memory. Benchmark the actual workload after checking correctness.

criteria.text: Uses workload evidence rather than one growth label.
